$comment: Targets in `make all` that intentionally do NOT run in CI. Checked by scripts/check_make_gate_coverage.sh. Adding a row is a deliberate decision to let a gate fire only on a developer's machine; every row needs a reason someone can audit. Prefer wiring the target into a workflow or into GATES in scripts/audit_gates.sh.

intentionally_local.reason: CI lints markdown with DavidAnson/markdownlint-cli2-action (ci.yml) against the same .markdownlint-cli2.jsonc, so the rules are enforced; the make target is the local convenience wrapper.
CI runs the workflow linter through lint-actions-source and lint-actions-harn, which are wired separately; this aggregate target exists for local use.
